title: docs: document WEATHER_API_KEY and test the timeout
description: Documents the API key variable and adds a test that the client passes a 10s timeout.
diff:
diff --git a/README.md b/README.md
--- a/README.md
+++ b/README.md
@@ -12,2 +12,6 @@
 pip install weather-sdk
 
+## Configuration
+
+Set `WEATHER_API_KEY` in your environment before calling the client.
+
diff --git a/tests/test_client.py b/tests/test_client.py
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_client.py
@@ -0,0 +1,8 @@
+from weather.client import get
+
+
+def test_get_uses_timeout(monkeypatch):
+    seen = {}
+    monkeypatch.setattr('requests.get', lambda url, timeout: seen.setdefault('t', timeout))
+    get('https://x')
+    assert seen['t'] == 10
